Population increased in North East Lincolnshire

The estimated population of North East Lincolnshire in 2024 was 159,911 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

This meant that North East Lincolnshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North East Lincolnshire increased by 1.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, North East Lincolnshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North East Lincolnshire

The average (median) age stayed at 43 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North East Lincolnshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North East Lincolnshire is an area that is classed as urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North East Lincolnshire's population of 159,911 usual residents was made up of:

  • 29,713 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.6%)
  • 95,608 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.8%)
  • 34,590 people aged 65 years and over, (21.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North East Lincolnshire has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (59.8% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North East Lincolnshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North East Lincolnshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North East Lincolnshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 451 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,447 births and 1,898 deaths in North East Lincolnshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 918 (0.6%). There were 5,562 people entering the area and 4,644 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North East Lincolnshire's population of 759 (0.5%) as a result of 1,165 people entering the area and 406 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North East Lincolnshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North East Lincolnshire in mid-2023 is 158,663.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 408 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 80 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 328 people.
